pages.title: Tinkers' Construct
pages.text: With Tinkers' Construct installed, integration includes tool materials based on Panakeia-enhanced materials and Singularity.$(br2)Check JEI for material processing, part recipes and modifier requirements.

pages.title: Panakeia
pages.text: A trait of Panakeia-enhanced ingots and gems, also found on Unite Alloy.$(br2)It improves durability and relevant equipment stats, including attack and projectile damage, mining and attack speed, draw speed, armor and armor toughness. Its level depends on the material.

pages.title: Super Polymerization
pages.text: A trait of Unite Alloy and Singularity material.$(br2)It adds upgrade slots and improves combat, mining and defense. Depending on the equipment type, it also provides effects such as Fortune, Looting, Silk Touch and improved movement in water.$(br2)The applicable effects depend on the tool or armor type.

pages.title: Akashic Records
pages.text: A trait of Singularity material that can also be applied as a modifier using Singularity.$(br2)It adds upgrade, ability and defense slots, increases attack damage, and reduces durability loss. On armor, it also increases the wearer's attack damage.$(br2)The modifier uses Singularity, not a Singularity Ingot.

pages.title: Singularity Material
pages.text: Singularity material carries a trait that builds up marks through melee and projectile hits. Repeated hits trigger an effect that kills the target.$(br2)On armor, the trait provides protection and reflects damage while marking the attacker.

pages.title: Treasury Modifier
pages.text: Apply the Treasury modifier to compatible melee or ranged weapons using a Singularity Ingot. It requires an ability slot.$(br2)Stored weapons perform follow-up attacks on melee or projectile hits. Storage follows the same rules as the $(l:singularity/constellation_treasury)Constellation Treasury$(/l).

pages.title: Storage and Removal
pages.text: Hold the modified weapon and press Open Treasury, bound to G by default, to open storage. Sneaking while using the weapon can also open it.$(br2)Storage is locked during follow-up attacks. Before removing the modifier, empty the storage and wait for all follow-up attacks to finish.
